_schema: SHARED, NEGOTIATED game configuration (book Appendix B). Both peers must hold a BYTE-IDENTICAL copy (rule 11); the pre-game exchange compares config_sha256 and refuses to play on any mismatch. Values follow Appendix F: PERMANENT terms may not change, MINIMUM terms may be raised by mutual agreement but never lowered.

pheromones._remark: pheromone_kernel selects which 5x5 emission table both peers use. 'book_table' is the literal Figure 4 table, so two teams reading the figure hash identically. 'gaussian' recomputes it from sigma^2 = 4/3, which reproduces Figure 4 to within 0.01 everywhere except the diagonal (0.43 vs 0.42). pheromone_transmit_lag is how many FULL turns a field is held before the opponent may sample it. IT IS 0 AS OF 2026-08-17, DOWN FROM 1, AND THE REASON IS THAT WE NEVER ACTUALLY AGREED 1 WITH ANYONE. The 14 hashed terms this pairing exchanges carry no lag key -- we adopted anrbj666's terms verbatim on the 15th -- and scent_models.kernel_fingerprint deliberately excludes the lag too, so neither of the two things we compare at handshake ever covered it. A comment in domain/smell.py called the lag 'agreed and already frozen by config_sha256'; anrbj666 compare terms, not config_sha256, so for this pairing it was frozen by nothing. Absence of the key means 0, and 0 is what their reference emits. They found it from the physics: a lag-1 field from a FROZEN thief is invisible, because the cell never changes -- which is why every window passed their gate until 2026-08-16, when roam_when_blind stopped our thief freezing. From a walking thief every frame shows the emitter one step behind where the movement law requires it, and their gate refused 34 of 35. The freeze fix did not break the frames; it unmasked a deviation that had been there all along. The cost of 0 is real and is ours to carry: a live field peaks on the cell we are standing on, which hands the position to a cop that reads it and makes our hints and deception layer far less valuable. That is the price of running the physics we actually agreed instead of the one that suited us. Both peers must run the same value, and a change here must be agreed on the thread first -- never shipped quietly, which is the whole lesson.
